name: Dhaka, Bangladesh
story: Explore which months were wetter or drier than normal around Dhaka, a city where heavy rainfall and drainage limitations can contribute to waterlogging.

name: Sylhet and surroundings, Bangladesh
story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Sylhet, a region where intense monsoon rain has contributed to severe flooding.

story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Tonle Sap, a lake whose seasonal expansion is connected to monsoon rainfall and water arriving from the Mekong.

story: Explore monthly rainfall differences from normal around Hue, where repeated storms and heavy rainfall caused extensive flooding in October 2020.

story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rainfall and greenness differences from normal near Manaus, in the Amazon rainforest, where the rivers fell to record lows in the droughts of 2023 and 2024.

name: Zagora, Morocco
story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rainfall differences from normal at Zagora, on the edge of the Sahara, a dry place where rain is rare and every wetter month stands out.

name: Leh, Ladakh, India
story: Draft intro (to be reviewed by Bormey): explore rain and snow differences from normal around Leh, a cold high-mountain desert in the Himalaya where winter snow feeds the rivers.
